mentions.name: logicgat.es
mentions.description: A digital logic educational board for connecting different logic gates together. The product includes clock functionality that adds timing to the logic, and a new release is currently in progress.
mentions.source_excerpt: As a hobby I´m working on my digital logic educational board. In the middle of releasing new product that where you can connect different logic gates together and I have added clock functionality that adds timing to the logic. https://logicgat.es
